relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: the expression of CGRP was evidently upregulated by capsaicin stimulation and reduced by sensory nerve ablation in the DRG of rosacea-like mice

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP treatment activated γδ T cells with increased the expression of Rora and Il17a

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP treatment also increased IL17A secretion

relationships.subject: rimegepant
relationships.evidence_quote: rimegepant decreased erythema and skin thickness

relationships.subject: γδ T cells
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that γδ T cells expressed high levels of Ramp1

key_findings: Capsaicin-activated Nav1.8+ nociceptors release CGRP, which recruits and activates γδ T cells (IL17A) to aggravate rosacea-like dermatitis.
CGRP receptor antagonist rimegepant attenuated nerve-mediated aggravation.
